incidents.summary: Payment service latency spike caused by slow DB queries during peak traffic
incidents.remediation: Optimize slow queries in payment-svc. Add connection pooling. Scale payment-db read replicas.

incidents.summary: Payment service packet loss causing transaction failures and retry storms
incidents.remediation: Investigate network interface. Check for NIC errors. Apply circuit breaker on checkout-svc.

incidents.summary: Inventory service crashes repeatedly due to OOM killer
incidents.remediation: Fix memory leak in inventory query cache. Set proper memory limits. Add graceful degradation.

incidents.summary: API gateway CPU saturation causing cascading latency across all downstream services
incidents.remediation: Scale api-gateway horizontally. Add rate limiting. Investigate CPU-heavy middleware.

incidents.summary: Payment DB memory exhaustion causing connection pool failures
incidents.remediation: Increase payment-db memory. Tune connection pool size. Add connection timeout on payment-svc.

incidents.summary: Auth service clock skew causing JWT validation failures
incidents.remediation: Sync NTP on auth-svc. Add clock skew tolerance to JWT validation. Monitor time drift.

incidents.summary: Log collector disk full causing log ingestion pipeline lag
incidents.remediation: Increase disk quota. Add log rotation. Alert on disk usage > 80%.

incidents.summary: Full network partition between frontend and api-gateway causing total service outage
incidents.remediation: Implement redundant network paths. Add health-check based failover. Deploy multi-AZ.

incidents.summary: DNS resolver slow lookups causing intermittent errors across all services
incidents.remediation: Add DNS caching layer. Use local DNS cache (dnsmasq). Monitor DNS latency.

incidents.summary: Checkout service returning 500 errors causing retry storm on payment and inventory
incidents.remediation: Rollback bad deployment. Add canary release. Implement circuit breaker on upstream callers.

incidents.summary: Cache service Redis connection failure causing elevated latency on api-gateway
incidents.remediation: Restart Redis. Check maxmemory policy. Add fallback to direct DB queries.

incidents.summary: Notification service Kafka producer timeout causing message backlog
incidents.remediation: Scale Kafka partitions. Increase producer timeout. Add dead letter queue.
